note: Open questions the Readbook is carrying: what we do not know. The run adds a question when an item turns on a fact nobody has published, and closes it with the answer and source when one appears. Never delete.

Who leads Ukraine's delegation and who represents France at the Abu Dhabi talks on 10–11 Nov?
items.answer: Rustem Umerov, head of the Foreign Intelligence Service, leads Ukraine's delegation; Le Monde reported that Emmanuel Bonne, head of the Élysée diplomatic office, represents France. [16, 26]
src: Europe to attend Ukraine peace talks as Kyiv's delegation heads to Abu Dhabi

items.q: What damaged the signal boxes near Cologne on 8 Nov, and was it deliberate?
items.answer: Federal police say an unknown man cut several signal cables at Köln Messe/Deutz early on 8 Nov; Cologne police call it a “Sabotagehandlung” and state-security police are investigating. A second cable fault in the night to 9 Nov is still being examined. [51]
src: Sabotage: Signalkabel an Kölner Bahnhof durchtrennt

On which motion (adopt, table or refer) does the House take up Massie's resolution, and how many Republicans vote against tabling?
items.answer: A motion to refer to the Judiciary Committee, adopted 211–204 on 10 Nov; tagesschau says Republicans voted almost as a bloc, and no party split was published in the reports read. [16, 105]
